fusions.name: Shriek Down the Line
fusions.desc: Sends a shriek into the first enemy in its path for 12 resonating damage; it leaps on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of that. Your afflictions on the first target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Leash of Thirst
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 8 blood damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Tethered Flit
fusions.desc: Snaps you to a point up to 6 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterward and have 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Locked Tendons
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
